name: Venture Helmet Carrack Edition
description: To celebrate 2950's Carrack Day, Anvil Aerospace partnered with RSI's armor division for a special version of their popular Venture helmet. Built with impact-resistant composites and an anti-scuff laminate faceplate offering an unparalleled upward field of view, the Venture Carrack Edition is white with grey accents and features the Carrack name and silhouette on the back.
